s: Ye wo commands hain jo bot ko "salaam dua" karti hain: bot zinda hai? kitna tez hai? menu kahan hai? Jaise ghar ka darwaza aur bell.
Ye ek bohot samajhdaar dost hai. Aap sawal likhte ho, wo sochta hai aur jawab likh deta hai. Har naam ek alag AI hai, jaise alag alag teacher.
Ye bot ke "dukandaar" hain: link ya naam do, wo cheez (video, gaana, photo, file) dhoond ke aap ko bhej dete hain.
Chhote chhote aise auzaar jaise aap ke bag mein scale, calculator aur dictionary hoti hai. Har command ek kaam ka tool hai.
Ye group ke "monitor" ki powers hain: sab ko bulana, kisi ko nikalna, admin banana. Zyada tar ke liye aap ka group admin hona zaroori hai.
Ye bot ke switches hain, jaise ghar ki light on/off. Ek command se koi feature chalu ya band hota hai.
Ye sirf bot ke malik ki chabi hain. Dusra banda likhe to bot mana kar dega.
Awaaz ke khilone: audio ko deep/robot/nightcore bana do, ya mazaidar sound effects chalao.
Photo ke doctor: dhundli photo saaf, chhoti photo bari, background hata do ya rang bhar do. Hamesha photo ko reply karke chalayen.
Duas, zikr, surahain, hadees aur Islami maloomat. Command likho, bot khubsurat tarah se bhej deta hai.
Sirf hasi mazaq. Group mein dosto ke saath khelne wali commands: jokes, truth/dare, ishq meter, random mazaaq.
Bot group ke members mein se kisi ko random aap ka dost/rishtedar bana deta hai. Sirf mazaq hai, group mein chalti hai.
Anime wali chhoti GIFs: hug, kiss, slap wagaira. Kisi ko tag/reply karo to wo uske liye bhejti hai.
Profile pictures (DP): random boy/girl/couple DP, ya kisi ki DP nikalna.
Ye sab dikhawe ki animations hain (fake hacking, emoji barish). Asal mein kuch hack nahi hota, sirf dosto ko hansane ke liye. Zyada tar sirf owner chalata hai.
Agar WhatsApp number ban ho jaye to bot tayyar likha hua appeal text deta hai. Aap isay copy kar ke khud WhatsApp support ko bhejte ho. Bot khud kuch nahi bhejta.
